external_collaboration.evidence_quote: As part of interagency efforts under the World Food Program (WFP), AIRD in Cameroon is working as the Third Party Monitoring partner, running with the checking of the important work being implemented by other partners as they meet the food needs of persons of concern in this area.

A team from AIRD led by the Business Dev’t & Strategic Partnerships Director, Oumar N’diaye, and Operations Director, Marc Meyer, met with a team from AFENET, led by Dr. Ditu Kazambu and Dr. Yaya Balayira, at AFENET’s premises to explore collaboration on Health & Humanitarian responses

We also thank the Office of the Prime Minister and our dedicated partners in the field, including LWF, IRC, and MTI, for their seamless coordination and cooperation. Their partnership ensured smooth access to sites and enabled our team to work effectively, making a tangible difference in the lives of those who need it most.
